correctness.rationale: At d=4,p=73, h=18 and Kyselov Proposition 4.1 yields equal k-th traces whenever lambda_k is nonzero. Exact rational recurrence and independent modular arithmetic give lambda_1=18, lambda_3=49, lambda_4=25, lambda_6=56 modulo 73. For nonzero trace, Newton identity tr(x^3)=tr(x)^3-3tr(x)Norm(x) yields identical minimal polynomials. At trace zero the one-dimensional trace kernel and degree-4/6 powers force scalar multiplier t^4=t^6=1 hence t=±1. This proves exactly Frobenius conjugacy; original Theorem 1.1 covers all other p. Galois action and stabilizer formula give both degrees; Burnside orbit count gives number of distinct sums. The standard-library checker independently reproduces rational coefficients and all 5328 parameter trace signatures. The premise is the published p-adic Proposition 4.1, not an assumed new computation.

value.rationale: The characteristic 73 is the unique excluded prime in the natural d=4 quadratic-extension family of a directly relevant 2026 distinctness theorem. Its recovery completes the whole conditional family, yields 2700 distinct values and degrees 18/9 there, and exemplifies a structural way to bypass a vanished logarithmic coefficient by higher traces and a trace-zero split. This is a motivated sharp boundary, not an arbitrary isolated congruence check.
